description: A research_log_append fulltext_search op that returned zero hits with a post-search filter (place, recordPlace0-3, recordType, yearFrom, yearTo) set and no unfiltered retry — a sibling fulltext_search with the same keywords/nlQuery whose filter-key set is a STRICT SUBSET of this op's, in the same batch (research.ops) or already in log[]. Silent for a name-field query, a query with no keywords/nlQuery term, a non-zero-hit op, and an op with no filter. Keyed on zero HITS, never on outcome. Replayed by the writer-tool precondition filteredNilRetryInvariants (research-log-append.ts).
format: expect: fire | silent, judged for the op named by `write` in research.ops (the op the preflight has already resolved — `query` is its sent query, `zeroHit` its resolved zero-hit state). research.ops are the other ops in the same batch; research.log is what earlier calls persisted. `ops[].id` is a test-fixture selector; the ResearchLogAppendOp type carries no id. Every fire case carries a `shape`; a guard needs at least two distinct fire shapes and at least one silent case.

cases.why: A filtered zero-hit fulltext op (the reachable path: logged with no staged ref, resultsExamined 0) whose keywords were never searched without the place filter.
A filtered zero-hit fulltext op whose staged payload recomputed to a count of 0 (defensive branch) with no unfiltered retry.
The unfiltered retry (same keywords, empty filter set, a strict subset of {place}) is in the same batch.
The unfiltered retry is already in log[] from an earlier call.
A name-field query has no stable sibling key — exempt.
A query with no keywords/nlQuery term — its unfiltered retry would drop its only field, which fulltext_search's validateInput refuses. Exempt.
A filtered search that had hits (zeroHit false) but was logged negative — keyed on hits, not outcome.
A zero-hit fulltext op with no post-search filter — nothing to retry without.
